verdict.rationale: Poke's own docs show email integration (read, search, draft) and calendar integration (schedule, check availability), with a general integrations system so Poke can access app information in conversation. No evidence names a cloud drive connector, and generic MCP extensibility is only a building block, not a documented drive connector. missing for 10: documented cloud drive connector (e.g. file search across a drive), evidence that connected data is searched and cited in answers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Email Management - Read, search, and draft emails without leaving your messages
Calendar - Schedule meetings and check your availability
Once connected, Poke can access information and perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation.
